facts.statement: Asio pythiotus is a newly described species of owl in the genus Asio.
facts.quote: Notes: An owl, a species of Asio.

facts.statement: Asio pythiotus is considered a valid taxon.
Fossils of Asio pythiotus date to the Pleistocene epoch.
The remains of Asio pythiotus were found in Crimea.
The Paleobiology Database currently has no specific record for Asio pythiotus.
facts.quote: NOTE: PBDB has no record for Asio pythiotus yet.

facts.statement: The species was described in the 2026 paper "Larger Owls (Aves: Strigidae) from the Lower Pleistocene of Crimea" published in Doklady Biological Sciences.
